answer: A sybil-resistant mechanism is stake-weighted reputation. Each agent deposits a bond measured in compute, and every claim is signed against that stake. Sampled at random, an honest agent builds a calm ocean of consistent work, while a sybil farm splits into shallow identities lacking the delta of trust. To scale fakes, an attacker must divide one bond across thousands of shards, each fake nearly weightless. Each identity must also mint a unique onyx proof of provenance to vote or earn. Duplicating identities demands duplicated compute, so cost compounds faster than reward.
